title: BFieldSliceResult
description: Response body for POST /api/bfield/slice. All field values in tesla. Grid is in Z-up frame. Outer array index corresponds to xGrid, inner array index corresponds to yGrid.

sliceZ.description: The Z height at which the slice was computed, metres.

xGrid.description: X coordinates of the grid points, metres. Length = resolution.

yGrid.description: Y coordinates of the grid points, metres. Length = resolution.

Bx.description: X component of B field, tesla. Shape: [len(xGrid)][len(yGrid)].

By.description: Y component of B field, tesla. Shape: [len(xGrid)][len(yGrid)].

Bz.description: Z component of B field, tesla. Shape: [len(xGrid)][len(yGrid)].
